method: NAIVE. Straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Work Injury Compensation Act 2019 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation in force from 1 December 2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/WICA2019.txt
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run wica-cases.l4 ; l4 run wica-liability-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 7 to 16, s 24 and s 34B, with First Schedule paragraphs 1, 2, 3 and 5 and Tables A and B. wica-tables.l4 holds the two multiplying tables, recovered from the PDF. wica-compensation.l4 has the employer's liability (s 7) and the money: death, total incapacity and partial incapacity, with both the pre- and post-1 November 2025 floors and caps. wica-liability.l4 has the three deeming rules in s 8, accidents outside Singapore (s 9), diseases (s 10), the principal (s 13), medical treatment (s 16 with First Schedule paragraph 5), the duty to insure (s 24) and the Part 3A substitution table (s 34B). NOT ENCODED: the claims procedure in Part 4, the designated-insurer regime in Part 3 Division 2, appeals, the AME computation in the First Schedule, the Second Schedule of occupational diseases, the Fourth Schedule of loss-of-earning-capacity percentages, and ss 34D to 34N individually, which are the platform-worker counterparts s 34B maps to.
